notes:
• Uses less memory when it turns on. The desktop picture is now loaded once and shared, instead of being loaded twice at the same time. The brief memory peak while starting is about a third lower, and TabStation uses less memory afterwards.
• Lighter background checks while you use apps. TabStation now checks whether HyperOS has hidden its Dock only when you switch apps, plus a check every 10 seconds, instead of every 2 seconds. Each check also asks the system for much less information.
• Faster window and split-screen checks.
• Smoother app switching. The Dock and taskbar no longer rebuild all their icons every time you switch apps. In Windows mode only the highlight moves to the active app.
• Notification Center, Control Center and the other menu bar and taskbar panels now close with a smooth animation, the reverse of how they open, instead of disappearing at once. This works when you tap outside, press Back, tap the same icon again or open another panel.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
